scope: Offline raw SRL smoke on all sixteen frozen field-development sentences, not independent evaluation or paper score reproduction
environment: .build/srl-preflight-env; existing layered HanLP2.1.7 plus fixed-source common0.0.24
download_limits: Three fixed archives only, one attempt each, 600s per archive; preserve partial files and failures. Exact declared sizes and ZIP CRC checks required; locally measured SHA256 identifies bytes, not publisher authenticity.
extraction_limits: No absolute/traversal/symlink members; max total uncompressed3GiB per archive; originals ignored by Git. No archive scripts executed.
execution: CPU4threads, seed0, two passes, tasks=srl, batch_size=4, raw input sentences with no gold predicates or fields. Block socket connections, HF offline, local resource alias maps, force torch weights_only=True and reject unsafe fallback. External wall timeout600s.
checks: raw output saved for both passes
token span bounds and text alignment
record model/package/file identities and empty frames
stop: Preserve load/inference failure; at most one local compatibility repair without changing model weights, task or inputs; no unsafe deserialization or new online assets. No case-specific semantic mappings.
interpretation: No six-field accuracy without a separately frozen mapping. ARG roles, predicate coverage and repeated output are not Rust truth, responsibility correctness or refactoring benefit. No claimed innovation merely from using SRL.
